name: Ningbo Boway Alloy Material Company Limited
summary: Ningbo Boway Alloy Material Company Limited research, develops, manufactures, and sells non-ferrous alloy materials in Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers copper alloy bars, copper alloy wires, copper alloy strips, precision cutting wires, precision electronic wires, welding wires, and solar photovoltaic products; and precision alloy wires, including high-conductivity superconducting materials, copper alloy products, wear-resistant bronze alloys, high-plastic brass alloys, high-corrosion-resistance cupronickel alloys, and environment-friendly alloys.
